sections.what_happened: SNSC chief Mohsen Rezaei, Parliament Speaker Qalibaf, and President Pezeshkian all told Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir Tuesday: no talks with Washington until 7 conditions met (ceasefire across Middle East, unfreeze assets, end port blockade, lift oil sanctions); 'Not a single gram of enriched uranium will leave Iran'
sections.what_verified: Three separate Iranian officials, same message, multiple regional outlets; Reuters exclusive (Oct 20) has Iranian officials saying Iran is 'preparing for renewed attacks, not a deal'
sections.what_disputed: Al Araby Al Jadeed claims US approved $6B mediation proposal and 'breakthrough could be announced this week' — now CONTRADICTED by Tuesday's Iranian statements; 0900-03 status moves to effectively cold
sections.why_matters: Three top Iranians told Pakistan's general the same thing on the same day: no talks until America moves first. The 'breakthrough this week' story is dead. Map card: frozen assets ($6B Qatar) + Hormuz
sections.context: Background: Iran diplomacy — 7 conditions, NO talks until demands met (Munir meetings)

totw_analysis: Our read: Three top Iranians told Pakistan's general the same thing on the same day: no talks until America moves first. The 'breakthrough this week' story is dead. Map card: frozen assets ($6B Qatar) + Hormuz The fault line our audience is arguing over: Maximum-resistance as leverage vs self-defeating pride — is Tehran's hard line extracting concessions or inviting the next strike?
